name: Bulk AI Product Content Generator – AI Product Tools for WooCommerce
author: Dogu Pekgoz

sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘ai-product-tools.zip’ to your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate AI Product Tools from the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Visit the Toolkit Dashboard to choose your preferred bulk generation mode
  4. Choose your preferred AI provider (OpenAI or Gemini AI)
  5. Enter and save your API key
  6. Customize your settings for your selected generator
  7. Start generating descriptions (single or bulk)
  8. Review and save your products
sections.faq:
Is AI Product Tools free to use?

Yes! AI Product Tools offers extensive free functionality. The Standard Bulk Generator is completely unlimited and free – no credit system at all! For the Advanced Bulk Generator with premium SEO and other advanced features, you get 250 monthly credits free. You only need an API key from your chosen provider (OpenAI or Google Gemini AI).

What’s new in the AI WooCommerce Toolkit Dashboard?

The new Toolkit Dashboard is your centralized control center for all AI tools! It features modern card-based interface where you can instantly compare tool capabilities, access quick settings, and manage your AI generators. This future-ready design seamlessly accommodates upcoming AI tools while giving you clear visibility of Standard vs Advanced features.

What’s the difference between Standard and Advanced Bulk Generators?

We offer two powerful generators to match your needs:

🏃‍♂️ Standard Bulk Generator (FREE):
– Unlimited usage – no credit limits ever
– Plain text output – clean, professional descriptions
– Basic SEO optimization – essential search benefits
– Multi-language support – generate in any language
– Simple workflow – one-click generation process

🚀 Advanced Bulk Generator (CREDIT-BASED):
– Advanced SEO-focused HTML output – rich formatting for better rankings
– AI Smart Parameters™ technology – automatic optimization for superior results
– Custom fields & variables support – precision targeting with {custom1}, {custom2}
– Edit before approve – perfect control over every description
– Generation history tracking – manage and track all content
– Improve existing content – enhance descriptions without starting over

How do I use custom fields with AI Product Tools?

Custom fields integration is available exclusively in the Advanced Bulk Generator. Here’s how it works:

  1. Add variables to your prompts: Include placeholders like {custom1}, {custom2} in your Advanced Generator templates
  2. Map variables to your existing fields: In Advanced settings, connect each variable to a specific custom field
  3. Generate content: The AI will automatically use your custom field values in the content with AI Smart Parameters™ optimization

This powerful feature is perfect for highlighting specific product features like materials, specifications, benefits, or any other custom attributes you already track. Combined with our AI Smart Parameters™ technology, it creates truly unique, targeted content that perfectly showcases what makes each product special!

How does the credit system work?

The credit system applies only to the Advanced Bulk Generator. The Standard Bulk Generator is completely unlimited!

Advanced Bulk Generator Credits:
1. Credit Usage: Each generation (descriptions and tags) for a product uses 1 credit
2. Monthly Renewal: Credits automatically refresh every month
3. Plan Allocations:
– Free Users: 250 advanced bulk generation credits monthly
– Pro Users: 5,000 advanced bulk generation credits monthly
– Business Users: Unlimited advanced bulk generation credits

Important Notes:
– Standard Bulk Generator: Completely unlimited, no credits needed
– Advanced features require credits for quality optimization and advanced functionality
– Credits refresh automatically each month (unused credits don’t carry over)

Why do we use a credit system for Advanced Bulk Generation?

The credit system for the Advanced Bulk Generator only works hand-in-hand with our exclusive AI Smart Parameters™ technology to optimize both cost and quality. While the credit system helps manage advanced resources efficiently, our AI Smart Parameters™ technology automatically fine-tunes the AI models for each specific task – adjusting temperature, frequency penalties, and other technical parameters that would normally require expert knowledge. This dual optimization means you get exceptionally high-quality content that’s perfectly tailored to your products, while we maintain an efficient system for premium features. Remember: the Standard Bulk Generator is completely unlimited and free!

How does the AI Smart Parameters™ technology work?

Our exclusive AI Smart Parameters™ technology is only available in the Advanced Bulk Generator and is a game-changer that eliminates the complexity of configuring AI models. Here’s what makes it special:

  1. Automatic Optimization: The system intelligently configures temperature, top_p, frequency and presence penalties based on your content needs
  2. Model-Specific Tuning: Different settings are applied for OpenAI vs Gemini models, and even between specific models
  3. Content-Type Adaptation: Parameters are tailored differently for short descriptions, full descriptions, and tag generation
  4. Continuous Improvement: Our API regularly updates optimal parameters based on the latest AI model changes and content performance data

This advanced technology ensures you get superior results without being an AI expert. While other plugins and our Standard Generator use basic settings, the AI Smart Parameters™ technology in Advanced Generator ensures you get the highest quality content possible for each specific task!

What happens if I run out of Advanced AI Description Generator credits?

When you run out of Advanced Bulk Generator credits, you have several options:
1. Switch to Standard Generator – Use our unlimited Standard Bulk Generator anytime
2. Wait for monthly renewal – Advanced credits automatically refresh each month
3. Upgrade your plan – Pro (5,000 credits) or Business (unlimited credits)

Which AI provider should I choose?

Both OpenAI and Gemini AI deliver excellent results in both Standard and Advanced Generators:

OpenAI (ChatGPT) – All latest models including GPT-4o, o1, o3-mini
– Excels in creative writing and engaging content
– Great for storytelling and persuasive descriptions

Google Gemini AI – Gemini 2.5 Pro, Flash, and 2.0 Pro models
– Provides more structured, technical content
– Excellent for detailed product specifications

Try both providers to find what works best for your products and preferred generator!

Is the content SEO-friendly?

Yes! Both generators create SEO-optimized content:

Standard Bulk Generator:
– Basic SEO optimization with keywords and product attributes
– Clean, search-engine-friendly plain text descriptions

Advanced Bulk Generator:
– Advanced SEO-focused HTML output with rich formatting
– Enhanced optimization using AI Smart Parameters™ technology
– Structured content that search engines love

Both consider keywords, product attributes, and SEO best practices while maintaining readability and engagement.

Can I customize the AI-generated descriptions?

Customization options vary by generator:

Both Standard & Advanced Generators:
– AI Provider selection (OpenAI or Gemini AI)
– Language preferences (any language)
– Writing style selection
– Description length control
– Brand voice settings
– Product attributes integration

Advanced Bulk Generator Exclusive Features:
– Custom prompts with variables ({custom1}, {custom2})
– Custom fields integration for precision targeting
– Advanced bulk generation templates
– Edit before approve functionality
– HTML-enabled rich content

The custom fields feature in Advanced Generator is especially powerful – it lets you take any product-specific information (technical specs, materials, benefits, etc.) and tell AI to specifically highlight these details. This creates truly unique content that perfectly showcases what makes each product special!

Is my data secure?

Yes! We prioritize security above all else. Here’s what you should know about data handling in AI Product Tools:

What we DO collect:
– Basic site information (WordPress version, PHP version, plugin installation date etc.)
– Usage statistics to improve the plugin (frequency of usage, which features are most used)
– Plugin functioning data such as API response success/failure rates
– Your plan type (free, pro, business) for providing appropriate service levels
– If you’re using Freemius: site URL, admin email, and license information (for license verification only)

What we DON’T collect:
– Your OpenAI or Google Gemini API keys (these are stored securely on your WordPress database only)
– Your product information (including categories, attributes, descriptions, prices, SKUs, etc.) – we never store any product data on our servers
– The full content of your product descriptions or generated content
– The prompts you use for content generation
– Customer data from your store

All data transmission is encrypted, and we implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information. Your API keys and product data remain on your WordPress installation and are never stored on our servers.

For more detailed information about how we protect your data, please see our full Privacy Policy.

What makes AI Product Tools different from other AI description generators?

AI Product Tools revolutionizes content creation with our unique dual-generator approach:

🛠️ Complete AI WooCommerce Toolkit – Centralized dashboard with tool comparison and quick access
🚀 Revolutionary dual-generator system – Choose unlimited basic or advanced professional features
🤖 Latest AI technology – OpenAI ChatGPT (including GPT-4o, o1, o3) and Google Gemini AI
🧠 Exclusive AI Smart Parameters™ – Automatic optimization technology (Advanced only)
🎯 Custom fields integration – Precision targeting with variables (Advanced only)
📝 Complete content solution – Descriptions, excerpts, and tags in one workflow
🔄 Content improvement technology – Enhance existing descriptions (Advanced only)
💰 Cost optimization – Up to 40%+ API cost savings (Advanced only)

Our focus on efficiency and scalability, combined with the choice between unlimited basic generation and advanced premium features, makes it perfect for both small shops and large WooCommerce stores.

What is the “Improve Descriptions” feature?

Our innovative “Improve Descriptions” feature is available in the Advanced Bulk Generator only and allows you to enhance your existing product descriptions without starting from scratch. Simply select the products you want to improve, click the “Improve Existing Products” option in the toolbar, and watch as AI enhances your content while maintaining your original messaging. Perfect for refreshing your product catalog or improving underperforming listings!

Can I keep parts of my existing descriptions when generating new ones?

Yes! Both generators offer the “Keep Existing Descriptions” feature, but with different capabilities:

Standard Bulk Generator:
– Basic preservation of existing content
– Simple content enhancement

Advanced Bulk Generator:
– Advanced content preservation with AI-powered analysis
– Intelligent content improvement while maintaining brand voice
– Edit before approve for perfect control

This gives you the perfect balance between fresh content and maintaining your established brand voice in both generators!
